title: Digital receivable creation failed
description: Emitted as the digital_receivable_create_failure event type when the asynchronous create flow rejects a digital receivable received through the create digital receivable API due to a business rule, such as a duplicated digital_receivable_id or a duplicated receivable. One event is emitted per rejected digital receivable. Consumers can use it to reconcile rejected registrations through error_code and error_details.

digital_receivable_id.title: Digital receivable ID
digital_receivable_id.description: Client-provided identifier of the digital receivable, up to 20 characters, unique per organization. Echoed from the rejected request.

lender_document_number.title: Lender document number
lender_document_number.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the lender, echoed from the rejected request.

debtor_document_number.title: Debtor document number
debtor_document_number.description: CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the debtor, echoed from the rejected request.

face_value.title: Face value
face_value.description: Face value in BRL with up to 5 decimal places, echoed from the rejected request.

maturity_date.title: Maturity date
maturity_date.description: Maturity date in yyyy-MM-dd format, echoed from the rejected request.

reason_type.title: Reason type
reason_type.description: Reason type echoed from the rejected request, from the ReasonType enum. LIVR: Livre, free of restrictions and available for negotiation. BLOQ: Comprometida, committed to a contract or negotiable instrument act. BQSD: Bloqueada pelo sacador, blocked by the drawer (lender). BQCJ: Bloqueada por constrição judicial, blocked by a court order. COMT: Completada, the receivable is settled. Absent when the request did not inform it.

error_code.title: Error code
error_code.description: Legacy business error code returned by the API explaining why the creation was rejected, for example 101052 (digital_receivable_id already registered) or 101055 (receivable with the same lender, debtor, face value, maturity date and tax invoice number already exists).

error_details.title: Error details
error_details.description: Structured error from the new error dictionary mapped from error_code. Absent when error_code has no mapping in the new dictionary.

code.title: Error code
code.description: Business error code from the new error dictionary in the 6-digit [MM][O][nnn] format (module, operation, sequence), for example 131043 for a duplicated digital_receivable_id or 131044 for a duplicated receivable.

description.title: Error description
description.description: Human-readable message for the new error code, not intended as a technical key.
examples: digital receivable already registered with this [digital_receivable_id]
